_meta.description: Gunslinger subclass passives: 3 stat-based (max 20 levels each). Focus: attack speed, armor pen, suppression.

subclass_passives.description_fr: Augmente la vitesse d'attaque de 0.8% et la chance de double attaque de 0.5% par niveau.
subclass_passives.description_en: Increases attack speed by 0.8% and double attack chance by 0.5% per level.

subclass_passives.description_fr: Augmente la penetration d'armure de 1% et les degats critiques de 0.5% par niveau.
subclass_passives.description_en: Increases armor penetration by 1% and crit damage by 0.5% per level.

subclass_passives.description_fr: Augmente la duree des debuffs infliges de 0.8% et la reduction de degats de 0.5% par niveau.
subclass_passives.description_en: Increases debuff duration inflicted by 0.8% and damage reduction by 0.5% per level.
